data.name: Gamali
data.gender_notes: Gamali is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is kind, gentle, and a true friend. The name Gamali carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Gamali usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are kind, compassionate, and possess a deep understanding of spirituality and the human condition
data.etymology: Gamali belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gamali total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جمالي
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعد اسم جمالي من أسماء الله الحسنى التي تؤدي إلى التفكير في جمال الله تعالى، حيث يرمز هذا الاسم إلى جمال الله الذي يظهر في خليقة الله، وفي آيات القرآن الكريم، وفي الحوادث التي تشهد لجمال الله في العالم. في اللغة العربية، يُشير الاسم إلى المظهر الخارجي المذهل، والمظهر الحسن، والجمال الكبير. في القرآن الكريم، يُستخدم هذا الاسم لوصف جمال الله في سور مثل سورة الفاتحة، وسورة الحديد، وسورة الحشر. يُعتبر اسم جمالي اسمًا فريدًا ومميزًا في اللغة العربية، حيث لا يوجد اسم آخر يُشير إلى جمال الله في cùng القدرة على التعبير عن هذا الجمال. في الثقافة الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم جمالي اسمًا مقدسًا، حيث يُرمز إلى التأمل في جمال الله، والمعرفة بالجمال الكبير الذي يظهر في الخليقة، وفي آيات القرآن الكريم.

in_urdu.name: جمالی
in_urdu.meaning: جمالی کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی زبردست خوبصورتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمالی نام اللہ کا ایک نیک نام ہے جو اللہ کی خوبصورتی کا خیال دل میں لاکر رکھنے کی دعوت کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کی خوبصورتی کے مختلف پہلوؤں کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے، جیسے کہ دنیا کے شہروں اور جھیلوں کے خوبصورت مناظر، اور انسانوں کے دل کی خوبصورتی۔ اس نام کے معنی کے ساتھ ساتھ، یہ نام اللہ کی رحمت اور کرم کا بھی بھی اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जमाली
in_hindi.meaning: जमाली का अर्थ है भगवान की सुंदरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: जमाली नाम एक ऐसा नाम है जो भगवान की सुंदरता को दर्शाता है। यह नाम हमें भगवान की सुंदरता के प्रति सजग बनाता है और हमें भगवान के प्रति शौकीन बनाता है। यह नाम हिंदू संस्कृति में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है और यह नाम भगवान की शक्ति और सुंदरता का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Gamali
in_english.meaning: Name Gamali means beauty of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gamali is derived from the Arabic root word 'Jamal' which means beauty or excellence. In Islamic tradition, the name Gamali is often associated with the beauty of God, and is seen as a symbol of God's greatness. In Arabic language, the word 'Jamal' is used to describe the external beauty of a person or thing, but in Islamic tradition, it takes on a deeper meaning, referring to the inner beauty of a person, their character and their actions. The name Gamali is often given to children born into Muslim families, as it is believed to bring blessings and good fortune to the child. In some Muslim cultures, the name Gamali is also associated with the name of a famous Islamic scholar, Imam Malik, who lived in the 8th century and was known for his knowledge and piety.

It is a name that speaks to the virtue of being a good companion and a gratifying soul to be around. data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Gamali holds deep significance in Islamic teachings as it represents the qualities of a virtuous and righteous individual. In the Islamic tradition, kindness and gentleness are considered essential traits for both personal and spiritual growth. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "None of you will enter Paradise until he is cut off from the Jaheem (evil) andalla reached the Firdos (Paradise), and none of you will reach the Firdos until he is forbidden stretch out his hands for spoils.(Sahih Muslim) Thus, by choosing the name Gamali, one may be reminded of the importance of cultivating kindness and gentleness in one's daily life, as a means of attaining spiritual growth and ultimately, entry into Paradise.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun writes about Gamali in his 'Muqaddimah'. Gamali was a Berber chieftain who rose to power in the Maghrib during the 13th century. He is known for his military conquests, particularly in Tunisia and Algeria.

Al-Maqqari mentions Gamali in his 'Nafh al-Tib' as a notable figure from the Banu Rasid dynasty in Morocco during the 16th century. Gamali is described as a learned man and a patron of scholars, who expanded the dynasty's territory and strengthened its power.
